Green, Yellow and Grey mean Preferred, Secondary and Other areas. Grey describes location preference, not safety. Green is not an official city-centre boundary. Budget, cost certainty and availability are independent labels; none is filtered initially.

Locations are supplied by the portals and may be approximate. Google Maps routes start from these coordinates. Verify the actual address before a viewing.
